Do you ride Trials or Enduro/Hard Enduro and looking for help to develop your riding?

Don't get lost in the misinformation that is out there, find some clarity and direction.  Trials and Enduro Skills - Neil Price, provides the information, direction and support that riders need to ride better, ride different!

This app is quite unique.  There is the information on how, what and why, covering all topics from turning, obstacles hills etc.  But rather than just topics, we look at the skills and break it all down to the smallest steps so riders can truely build their skills.

Then there is the community, where you get to see others riding, and share in the learning experience.  Neil feeds back to videos and questions and does so to the community so everyone can learn.

Neil's coaching is quite unique as it has evolved out of his own experience of finding vague, and unclear guidance.  He breaks things down, and can articulate them clearly for the normal rider, and delivers them in an ordered progression. 

The core line of content is being built out and later in 2023 a progressive program for trials riders will be added.

At the moment you get;
- Access to all the Knowledge Videos and content (being built out and added to each week)
- Neil's Feedback on your videos, that you post, or if you prefer upload privately to him
- The back catalogue of content in the Library
- Access to book time to discuss any problems you may have
   
Access is either monthly or annually
